items.content: Devtools must be 1️⃣ open source and 2️⃣ universally extensible. AI coding agents are the most important devtools in the history of our industry. The Plugin standard lets anybody extend them uniformly. This is huge for the ecosystem. Build a Plugin → get exposure to the tidal wave of software creation from every agent: CLIs, IDEs, cloud agents, and even personal assistants.
